repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire at 29000 ms. The IR requires a 30-second duration, which corresponds to 300 ticks of 100 ms. The mismatch occurs because the candidate counts iterations (30) instead of milliseconds (300), and the 1000 ms wrapper cannot observe the condition drop-and-recover between iterations to measure the exact 30-second window correctly. The IR waits for 30 seconds (30000 ms), but the candidate fires after 29000 ms (29 iterations).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period to 100 ms to allow the hold counter to track time accurately on the required grid. Updated the threshold from 30 to 301 (30 seconds / 100 ms + 1) to ensure the action fires exactly at the 30-second mark, matching the IR's 'for: 30 SEC' requirement.
